svg.title: RIEMANN · MAP R2 — The proof, chapter by chapter: what each chapter of the blueprint proves, and which chapters use which
svg.desc: The blueprint reads Alpöge's formal proof as nine chapters: the main theorems, an outline, five chapters that each carry out one stage of the argument, and a chapter of published results. Each card is one chapter: the Lean declaration of the theorem it proves, the chapter's own introduction, its sections with the number of statements in each, and the chapters it uses. An arrow from A to B says that chapter B uses chapter A; read it from the foot up, as diagram R1. The table at the foot counts which published results the proof leans on most. No Lean was built for the blueprint; see band 5 of diagram R1 for what is known about the formal proof. Map mode: nothing of the blueprint's text or the proof's source is quoted.
svg.text: RIEMANN · MAP · R2

Blueprint chap-literature/

The Lean panel is the signature of the theorem at the chapter's root, the one the chapter exists to prove, as lean-facts.json records it; cut at eight lines. The footer names it and gives its file and line in
the mirror.
The line in italics is the first paragraph of the chapter's own introduction, abridged where marked with …. The bullets are its sections in order, each with the number of statements under it.
Uses and Used by are the chapter uses lines of the blueprint. An arrow from A to B: chapter B uses chapter A, and the arrow takes A's colour.
Colours: the chapters of the new argument are green, the published results blue, the main theorems amber and the outline grey.
